name: BlinkSend
description: Fast, private, peer-to-peer file sharing directly between browsers. No account or cloud storage.

paragraphs: Fast, private file sharing directly between browsers.
No account. No cloud file storage. Pair two devices, verify the peer, and send.
0.4.0-beta.5 · WebRTC · resumable transfers · SHA-256 verification · self-hostable
features: Direct when possible: WebRTC connects the two browsers directly; TURN can relay encrypted traffic when direct connectivity fails.
Built for interrupted transfers: numbered chunks, missing-range resume, and reload recovery on browsers with persistent file handles.
Self-hostable: Node.js, Docker/Compose, health checks, reverse-proxy guidance, optional TURN, and Prometheus-style metrics.
Cross-browser tested: automated Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit pairing + verification + WebRTC messaging checks.

Simple Send / Receive entry flow for computer ↔ computer and phone ↔ computer sharing through an invite link, QR code, or an eight-character manual pairing code. Manual codes expire after 10 minutes, the sender UI shows…
